name: GD Mobile Stats
description: Streams real-time stats and allows StartPos / respawn remote control from a mobile phone over USB (ADB) or Wi-Fi.

server-port.name: Server Port
server-port.description: Port used by the WebSocket server (default 34567)

enable-adb-reverse.name: Enable USB ADB Reverse
enable-adb-reverse.description: Automatically run 'adb reverse' so phone connected via USB-C connects seamlessly

adb-interval-seconds.name: ADB Check Interval (s)
adb-interval-seconds.description: How often to check and re-apply adb reverse in the background

simulate-keys.name: Simulate Keys for MegaHack
simulate-keys.description: Send Windows key inputs (Q/E for StartPos, R for Respawn) for full MegaHack compatibility
